title: Being Conformed to the Image of Jesus
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he dives into the transformative power of conforming to the image of Jesus Christ. In this sermon, Pastor Chris reveals how the testings of our faith are not obstacles, but opportunities for us to be shaped into the likeness of our Savior, and how we can rejoice in the midst of trials, knowing that our faith will be refined like gold in the fire and made more precious in the eyes of God. Listen to learn how to let go of a comfortable Christianity and pursue a deeper, more authentic walk with Jesus.
